### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name the muster tool behind call_tool on approval rows and hide the runtime's confirmation hint](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3504) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a session, an agent's `Approval requested` row names the tool it wants to run and its connector, instead of Call tool, and opening it shows that tool's arguments. The technical "Please approve or reject…" message no longer appears.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.39.0...v3.39.1
